issues.finding: Basic and Advanced owners retain fixed Council/Cabinet sizes, a frozen 2019 committee count and obsolete universal chairmanship claims contradicted by the dated official notification.
The Basic/Advanced owners misdate Ambedkar's Hindu Code Bill resignation as 1953 rather than 1951.
The 2020 PYQ is mischaracterised as a direct Union-minister question; the official paper asks a State-minister/RPA combination and requires Article 164(4), with Article 75(5) only as an analogue.
Three PYQ solutions and seven original Mains models contain marks rationales but no answer-specific How to improve or executable compression guidance.
Generated MCQ headings do not evidence strict A-B-C-D rotation, while remediation advertises B-B-C-D; generated prose also contains heuristic generic/truncated trap sentences.
Nine graphical stages and nine ASCII panels compress 24 Core sessions and omit independent Article 77, Article 78, current committee-control, PYQ and answer-execution routes.
The current package uses in-place g2 repair provenance and stale generation-local paths rather than a fresh immutable reviewed identity.
